# frame solver

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:frameSolver`](gmeow-frameSolver.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/frameSolver>

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to identify the external solver or transformation method that resolves coordinates in a frame.

### Avoid when

- Avoid encoding solver results as asserted triples ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).

### How to use

- Set [`gmeow:frameSolver`](gmeow-frameSolver.md) as a literal naming the method; it directs the solver layer that executes [`gmeow:transformsTo`](gmeow-transformsTo.md).

### Examples

- ex:siteGrid [`gmeow:frameSolver`](gmeow-frameSolver.md) "proj:EPSG:4326".
